title: Assistance Coordination Note: Down-Payment Share Deducted on a Re-figured Patient Payment Plan Offer
content:
**Rule.** The down-payment share deducted when an unsigned **Patient Payment Plan** offer is re-figured follows the open application's screening: none for a household screened at or below 200 percent of the federal poverty level and 5 percent for one screened above 200 and at or below 400 percent, each only on tiers whose down payment percentage is higher; otherwise it is the tier's down payment percentage. The deduction is that share of the re-figure balance, rounded half-up to the cent.

**Open application.** A financial assistance application of the patient is open when one of the patient's financial assistance cases in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) stands in submitted or pending documents status, a submitted case being taken first. The screening is the household federal poverty level (FPL) percentage on that application in the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care).

| Tier | Tier down payment (percent) | At or below 200% FPL | Above 200%, at or below 400% FPL | Otherwise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Riverbend Short-Term Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Riverbend Standard Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Riverbend Extended Payment Plan | 10 | 0 | 5 | 10 |
| Riverbend Long-Term Payment Plan | 10 | 0 | 5 | 10 |
| Riverbend Assistance-Linked Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Riverbend Hardship Payment Plan | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 |

**Hypothetical.** A re-figure balance of 4000.00 on a tier with a 10 percent down payment: at 180 percent FPL nothing is deducted; at 310 percent, 200.00; at 450 percent, 400.00.
